title: Classifying Brazilian Monetary Policy States with Interest Rate Gaps and Markov Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.33291v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a monthly framework for classifying Brazilian monetary policy that distinguishes the level of monetary restraint, changes in that stance, and statistical regimes associated with Selic adjustments. The framework combines a seven-state deterministic classifier, an empirical Markov chain, a Gaussian hidden Markov model, and Markov-switching regressions. Project outputs provide 145 classified observations from May 2014 to May 2026, with a partial final month. Under the implemented nominal neutral rate convention, restrictive states account for 88.3% of observations. A four-state HMM achieves a lower BIC, whereas the three-state model records a lower temporal validation loss. Switching regressions select three Selic adjustment regimes after solutions with degenerate variances are excluded. translated_title: 利用利率缺口与马尔可夫模型对巴西货币政策状态进行分类
translated_abstract: 本文开发了一个按月对巴西货币政策进行分类的框架，该框架能够区分货币紧缩的程度、政策立场的变化以及与Selic利率调整相关的统计状态。该框架结合了七状态确定性分类器、经验马尔可夫链、高斯隐马尔可夫模型以及马尔可夫转换回归。项目输出提供了2014年5月至2026年5月期间共145个分类观测值（最后一个月份为不完整数据）。在所采用的名义中性利率约定下，紧缩状态占全部观测值的88.3%。四状态隐马尔可夫模型取得了更低的BIC值，而三状态模型则记录了更低的时间验证损失。在剔除方差退化的解之后，转换回归选定了三个Selic调整状态。额外的敏感性分析显示，当中性利率基准被解释为实际利率时，紧缩状态占比降至51.0%，这表明……
tldr: 本文构建了一个融合确定性分类器、马尔可夫链、隐马尔可夫模型和马尔可夫转换回归的月度框架，用于分类巴西货币政策状态，并揭示中性利率的不同解释会使紧缩状态占比在88.3%与51.0%之间显著变化。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a monthly framework combining deterministic classifiers, Markov chains, hidden Markov models, and Markov-switching regressions to classify Brazilian monetary policy states, showing that the share of restrictive states varies from 88.3% to 51.0% depending on how the neutral rate benchmark is interpreted.
